description: Launch a hands-off, paced analysis sweep: runs Phase 1 across every repo, then Phase 2, keeping at most `concurrency` analyses in flight so the operator OAuth token window is never exhausted. Seed from a programId (derives repos from its initiatives) or an explicit repos list. Re-seeding overwrites the current sweep. Requires `write` scope.

programId.description: Derive the repo set from this program’s initiatives.

repos.description: Explicit repo full names ("owner/name"). Used when programId is omitted.

name: anyforge_start_coverage_sweep
title: Start coverage sweep
